title: Tricks and glitches
text: Video games are made by people, and people make mistakes. A glitch is an error in the code of a game. For most players, glitches are annoying. For speedrunners, they are treasure.

Some glitches allow you to walk through walls. Others let you skip whole levels or even jump straight to the final scene. Finding these errors involves testing the game in strange ways, like pausing at a precise moment or walking against a corner for minutes.

Speedrunners love sharing their discoveries. When someone finds a new glitch, the community starts practicing it immediately. Many tricks require pressing buttons in a window of a few milliseconds, so executing them is incredibly hard.

Because glitches can change a game completely, speedrunners divide their races into categories. In an any% run, using glitches is allowed. In a glitchless run, players avoid using any error. This way, everyone competes under the same rules.
Some developers hate their games being broken, but many enjoy watching speedruns. A few even include secret shortcuts on purpose. After all, finding new ways to play is part of the fun of gaming.

grammar.title: Grammar: verbs + -ing
grammar.rule: After some verbs and prepositions, the next verb takes -ing: love, enjoy, avoid, start, involve... An -ing verb can also be the subject of a sentence.
items: In a glitchless run, players avoid ___ errors.
